maddeler.e:
نتعايش (form VI)
# نَتَعَايَشُ (nataʕāyašu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ja.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# نَتَعَايَشَ (nataʕāyaša) /na.ta.ʕaː.ja.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# نَتَعَايَشْ (nataʕāyaš) /na.ta.ʕaː.jaʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
